title: Read-phase transition function
statement: For a fixed number $m$ of work tapes, two tape indices $r,s	ext{ in }	ext{Fin}(m)$, a state assignment from read-phase labels to states, and a state assignment from optional Boolean values to states, define a transition function. Its input is a read-phase label, the symbol (or blank) under the selected work-tape head, and the symbols (or blanks) under all work-tape heads; its output is a one-step action of an $m$-work-tape machine over the Boolean alphabet. The transition cases implement equality checks and counter updates, move to the appropriate answer or return phases, and clear the selected register as specified by the corresponding read phase.
hypotheses_covered: A state assignment for every read-phase label
A state assignment for every optional Boolean value
caveat: The exact actions depend on helper transition definitions that are present in the formal snippet but have no informal descriptions among the supplied definitions.
